t:
In this Act—
    (1) the terms “abuse”, “adult protective services”, “elder”, “elder justice”, “exploitation”, “law enforcement”, and “neglect” have the meanings given those terms in section 2011 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1397j); 
    (2) the term “elder abuse” includes abuse, neglect, and exploitation of an elder; and 
    (3) the term “State” means each of the several States of the United States, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, and any other territory or possession of the United States.

fable.w: This section only defines terms used in the Act (abuse, elder abuse, State, and so on). The mention of "State" might look like outside-party involvement, but it is purely definitional. The section sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government.
fable.s: the term “State” means each of the several States of the United States, the District of Columbia, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, and any other territory or possession of the United States.

Defining terms is a legislative drafting technique, not a mechanism for public participation.
